about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (1 Samuel 20:18–42) is read because tomorrow is Rosh Chodesh, and it replaces Beresheet’s usual haftarah. It opens with “Tomorrow is the new moon” and tells of Jonathan’s covenant loyalty to David, the king God has chosen. The reading from the Apostles (Luke 1:26–33) picks up that promise to David: Gabriel announces that the Son born to Miriam will be given the throne of his father David and will reign forever.
